about: Alex's approvals of exact intervention proposals, by the id interventions/register.json gives each. A trust-root file (AUTOMATION.md H3): it changes only in a pull request a human approved. An approval of an agent-task proposal lets automation/interventions.mjs open it; a people proposal is only ever sent by Alex, who records here when it was sent (enacted), so its effect is measured from then. Each entry names the project-thread message that approved it.
